'''Al T. Nadder's Repair Shop''' was a garage and repair business operating in the resort of [[Le Yer]] on [[Abregado-rae/Legends|Abregado-rae]]. It was owned and operated by the [[Devaronian/Legends|Devaronian]] [[Al T. Nadder]].<ref name="ARI" />
